text: honestly the hose feels useless, I sprayed a burning house for ages and it never went out, and my friend got stuck carrying the dog with no way to drop it

triage.summary: The tester found the hose ineffective at putting out a burning house, and a friend got stuck carrying a dog with no way to drop it.

anomalies.title: Hose does not extinguish fire
anomalies.expected: Sustained spraying on a burning house reduces its fire and extinguishes it within a reasonable time.
anomalies.observed: The tester sprayed a burning house for a long time and it never went out. No round telemetry was provided (rounds list is empty), so fires_extinguished, water_used and fires_spread cannot confirm or contradict this. It could be a low extinguish rate, fire regrowing or spreading faster than the hose output, or the water not registering hits on the house.

anomalies.title: No way to drop a carried pet
anomalies.expected: A player carrying a civilian or pet can drop or release it at any time (for example with a key or button), and delivery at truck 67 releases it automatically.
anomalies.observed: The tester's friend carried the dog and could not drop it, leaving them stuck in the carry state. No telemetry (rescued counts, errors, events) is available to verify, so it is unclear whether the drop action is missing, unbound, or failing after pickup, or whether it is a stuck state after a failed delivery.

auditor_missed: No way to drop a carried pet
